tools.name: get_evidence_head
tools.description: The current signed head of the evidence log: tree size, Merkle root and signature. Save it: any later head must be consistent with it.

tools.name: get_inclusion_proof
tools.description: Proof that the entry at leaf_index is in the tree, optionally at a given tree_size. Checkable offline with the public verifier.

tools.name: get_consistency_proof
tools.description: Proof that the tree at size first is a prefix of the tree at size second (or now): the log never rewrote history.

tools.name: get_checkpoint
tools.description: The log's signed checkpoint in the C2SP format witnesses cosign (origin, size, root).

tools.name: get_ledger_attestation
tools.description: The signed head hash of the hash-chained audit ledger of recorded quotes.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: How much is recorded, and by how many keys that are not ours. Counts only, nothing about anyone.

tools.name: record_evidence
tools.description: Record the SHA-256 of a decision record you keep yourself, so it can later be shown to be unchanged. Send the digest and a short kind, never the record. Needs your RiskRouter key in the Authorization header of the MCP connection. Entries are permanent.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "record_evidence" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
